hardware: three ASUS GX10 and one DGX Spark (GB10), two 100 Gb/s switched RoCE rails per node
profile: native production s1387 environment, except host-specific NCCL device settings (from the private inventory) and in-memory event logging
weights: existing canonical staged atlases and Engram backing; not empty-fleet provisioning

derived_matrices.tool: tools/stage_full_matrices.py: extract on each node, assemble on the head

limitations: Existing atlases were reused; checkpoint download, Engram packing and GPU weight staging were not repeated.
Short serving, image and benchmark checks; the native s1387 stress and cancellation panels were not repeated on the portable package.
Temperature-0 output identity covers the 24 published-client requests.
